display: Bangkok — Chao Phraya River pier corridor
summary: The Chao Phraya is Bangkok's working water artery: ~40k boardings/day on diesel express boats today, with piers wired directly into BTS/MRT and the city's marquee riverside destinations. The Sathorn (Central) <-> Phra Arthit spine, anchored by ICONSIAM and Asiatique at the ends, is a ready-made electric-shuttle corridor where pedestals can sit at existing municipal piers.

micro_demand: ~40k daily Chao Phraya express-boat boardings (diesel today) — direct modal-shift target.
BTS Saphan Taksin interchange at Sathorn concentrates commuter + tourist transfer flow.
ICONSIAM and Asiatique generate dedicated leisure shuttle demand independent of commuter lines.

signature_journeys.note: Core river spine; pier-exact sealed journey.

navier_fit: Very high for in-river operations: short, dense, schedule-predictable corridors with existing municipal piers for pedestal siting and a large diesel ridership base to convert. Gulf-gateway (river-mouth to sea) remains roadmap/needs-mint — keep tagged aspirational.

grab_overlay.super_app_fit: Grab in-app river-shuttle booking with BTS/MRT and GrabCar last-mile handoff at Sathorn.
grab_overlay.wedge: Convert the 40k/day diesel express-boat base into a quiet, pre-booked electric lane inside Grab, pier-to-pier with land-leg stitching.
